newsitem.title: GERMANY: Spot N.Europe rapeseed prices firm on tight supply.
newsitem.headline: Spot N.Europe rapeseed prices firm on tight supply.

text.p: Rapeseed prices in northwest Europe edged higher on tight supply and trade buying interest, but 1997 shipment dates look set to ease, brokers said on Friday.
A firmer tone in the Chicago soy complex as a result of good crushings and export demand for products also lent support.
November buyers free Hamburg were up five marks on the week at 460 marks for November, with sellers five marks higher.
An absence of Canadian canola sales due its high price and rapeseed demand from Scandinavia also boosted the spot market.
But physical trade volumes in the north were slim because soybeans and sunseeds offered crushers better margin while competitive French rapeseed dominated southwestern markets.
Rapeseed buyers at points other than Hamburg offered 440-455 marks for November, compared with last week's 445-467 range.
December traded at 451 cif Lower Rhine and December bids free Salzgitter were at 462.50.
January buyers of French seed fob Moselle offered 1,480 francs versus 1,510 last week.
Spot meal and oil sold reasonably well in domestic markets but forward dates were easier and export markets for rapeseed oil were paralysed by a price premium over soy.
This was partly a result of concern among European consumers over the safety of genetically altered U.S. soybeans.
But crushers were busy processing soybeans, ignoring the protests by environmental groups in recent days, brokers said.
Oelmuehle Hamburg AG, the target of a Greenpeace protest action this week, said it had not altered crushing schedules.
The sellers premium for rape oil over soyoil was four to 5.25 guilders at midday in Rotterdam per 100 kg/fob mill.

Local Nov rape meal sellers (34 percent protein) were 0.25 marks higher at 30.25-30.50 marks/100 kg on active spot buying, but Dec was merely steady at 29.50 marks and Jan/April was 0.25 lower at 28.50.
Local Dec rape oil sellers were at 83.0 marks/100 kg compared with a Nov/Jan range of 83.75 marks last week. Feb/April oil was at 84.75, off 0.25.
